Assuming rational behavior, bidders with values close to $25 might bid around $20-$25. To maximize profit, I will bid slightly above the midpoint of this range. This ensures a good chance of winning while maintaining profitability, as the third-highest bid will likely be lower.

This strategy balances the risk of losing with the potential profit margin.
